answer: The beacon counter is kept in onyx and sonnet shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 44 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 44 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 362 aliases cost 337 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
